mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a FEDFUNDS increase > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within the last month signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, thereby positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a UNRATE decrease > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over the last two months indicates growing demand for housing and related goods, which positively impacts the broader economy and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a sustained increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% over the last two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a significant INDPRO decrease.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2%, signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following the combined labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over the last five months indicates strong consumer demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a sustained increase in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% over the last month signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to tighter monetary policy and negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances following a significant CPIAUCSL increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 1% over the last two months signals weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a significant RSAFS decrease.
